The '''Quanducial system''' was located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarch]] known as the [[Princess of Quanducial]].<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Quanducial [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
